X-ray flare.requires: a solar flare on the visible disc
X-ray flare.provides: effect at the speed of light with no warning at all, minutes of high-frequency radio blackout

Solar energetic particle event.provides: arrival within tens of minutes, radiation hazard at altitude, no ground currents

Coronal mass ejection.requires: an ejection directed at the earth
Coronal mass ejection.provides: one to three days of transit warning, geomagnetically induced currents at ground level

Solar radio burst.requires: broadband radio emission from the sun
Solar radio burst.provides: interference on the sunlit hemisphere only, no particle or magnetic effect

High-voltage transformer.requires: a long conductor grounded at both ends
High-voltage transformer.provides: saturation and heating from induced currents, months to replace a failed unit

Satellite in orbit.provides: charging and single-event upsets, no shielding by the atmosphere

Polar aviation route.requires: flights at high latitude and altitude
Polar aviation route.provides: crew radiation dose and loss of high-frequency communication, reroutable at a fuel cost

Precision positioning service.provides: degraded accuracy from ionospheric disturbance, no hardware damage

Forecast from a solar observatory.requires: a spacecraft at the sun-earth line
Forecast from a solar observatory.provides: fifteen to sixty minutes of warning of arrival, no warning for light-speed effects

Grid operator load reconfiguration.requires: hours of notice and switching capability
Grid operator load reconfiguration.provides: reduced induced current path, loss of transfer capability

Satellite safe mode.requires: onboard autonomy and a command link
Satellite safe mode.provides: protection of the payload, loss of service during the event

Reroute aircraft to lower latitudes.provides: dose reduction, longer flights and schedule disruption

No operational effect.requires: the event below the threshold for any system

Temporary service degradation.provides: reduced accuracy or availability, full recovery
